- Public MIT Claude Code skill for idea tournaments: `SKILL.md` plus a single Workflow script `arena.js` (286 lines). Many cheap agents each pitch an idea, then fight in a single-elimination bracket with a 3-judge final panel and an optional web novelty check on the top 4.
- Recent history, from the commit log: added 2026-10-02 in three commits (initial skill, lean Explore-type agents with documented token cost, then Arena v2 with originality scoring, final judge panel, web novelty check, seeds and criteria). No code was changed in this release.
- October 2026 review: both external README links returned HTTP 200. Added in this release: a CHANGELOG, a README Status line, and a Work with SkynetLabs section. The repo has no package.json, so there was no version to bump.
- Known gaps: the README itself warns the winner is the most persuasive 60-word pitch to a small model, not a verdict, and contestants have no tools so figures in pitches are invented; no tests or CI, and this pass did not run a tournament.
